reviews.text: This is the only groomer my 10 year old mini schnauzer has been that she hasn't been scared or anxious about it. She comes home happy and pretty every time! Exactly as I ask for even if that means she leaves with a mullet 🤣 I love this groomer and if they took cats they'd have all my grooming business! Lilly loves you too!

Gemma has been seeing Raquel for almost 10 years! As Gemma has aged, Raquel has been able to work with all her to accomodate all of her old age issues. Besides the fact the team at Fur Sure are all amazing humans, its also a very sanitary grooming studio which is so amazing to expierance. Plus, do you see my girls sick Mohawk and purple color?!?!?! 💜

These ladies are AMAZING! I have a rescue and Racheal took care of all 8 of my babies. She even took care of a friend of mines dog...last minute, before Christmas! My dogs are special needs, but when they went to Rachael after I told her the issues with each one of them, they made a liar out of me and acted normal! That's Rachae⁷l's special touch! Anyhow, I love this place! If you are looking for a great grooming shop where you can drop your babies off, and not worry about them, and get the best Groom ever, this is the place to go. Thanks Audrey and Rachael!!!
Amazing service and quality! My (very large and hairy) pup has never looked better! Audrey was great and you can tell she really cares for animals. 10/10 recommend!
Raquel, is amazing with My dog at 15 years old. I've observed her with many other dogs. She is great at what she does please Consider using her as a groomer!
I have followed Audrey for years until she opened her own place. All 5 of my dogs love her! And they are all different breeds. She is amazing and I will not see anyone else❤️
Audrey is fantastic and our pup loves going there. She does such a nice job! Thank you Audrey.
Raquel is so patient and gentle with our little one. She looks amazing and is so happy!  Thank you!!
First time but not our last time! Our pups were so well taken care of and came home looking and feeling wonderful! So glad we found you. We’ll be back!
I couldn’t ask for a better groomer than Raquel!! She’s very gentle w my dogs & she genuinely loves them, & they love her!! I’m thankful that I found them!! 🐾❤️🐾
Only wish there were more stars to give this studio experience. The owners are exceptionally talented groomers and kind in a way that only comes from the heart, authentic and sincere.

Audrey is truly a gem.  The true dog whisperer/ groomer.  I have followed Audrey all over the valley because she is that exceptional.  My Maddie unfortunately was not born a healthy dog.  She has IVDD and now she is in remission with lymphoma.  Both issues require a caring and loving person.  Audrey is  💯 that.  She is so patient and kind towards my girl but all the dogs she grooms.  My Mads is so beautiful when she works her magic.  She loves all the dogs she grooms and they love her back!  I am the worst " helicopter " pet parents out there.  I trust Audrey 💯.   I love her and so does my girl.  She is that special light that shines.  Thank you for loving my girl as much as I do if not even more....❤️❤️❤️
Very happy we were referred to Audrey! She’s amazing 🤩
Audrey is the best!!  My dog has been going to her for years now and she always take great care of him.

Both owners and groomers are so kind to our dog Mokie and always do a GREAT grooming.  He is treated well and we appreciate how professional and friendly Raquel, our groomer is. Our dog is part of their family not just a customer!!  EC

My experiences at Fur Sure have all been 5 ⭐️.  The owners and operators of this pet salon are consistently outstanding in every way!  I highly recommend their care and services to any one with a furry family member.  More than once they have noticed something I had not, and helped my fur child avoid a prolonged issue.  They truly care about our fur babies AND the quality of their work.

Thank you Fur Sure!

I found this place based on google reviews and distance *. The space is very welcoming, Audrey did such an amazing job with my 14 week old parti yorkie. My baby got so comfortable with her which made me feel comfortable. She did a fantastic job with his grooming and cut. She even sent me before and after. Thank you Audrey and fur sure grooming. 🩷

Very friendly and accommodating staff, excellent job, and my dog was clearly very comfortable there even though it was his first time in! Not a million crying or barking dogs in the back room like some places.
Best in town
Jaxson had a great time getting his pedicure done with a bath. He looks so handsome.
Audrey & Raquel are awesome. They take wonderful care of my dogs. I totally recommend their services. My doggie got his spring shave.
The best

Audrey is a god send, she’s been working with my Pup for years now I’ve followed her wherever she may go. She’s caring, efficient, and hands down the best groomer that makes me feel comfortable leaving Klaus behind in good hands.
They did such an awesome job with my girl. Corrina, I will definitely be back.
This is a Beautiful shop with Beautiful people!  They treated my Penny like they really care.  & gave me pointers on maintaining her coat.
My 2 dogs have been going to Raquel for at least a decade. She is so sweet. My dogs can be fickle sometimes and she makes them so comfortable.
does an excellent job on my longhaired doxie! tried others after they moved and they all sucked!! So glad we found her again.  highly recommend!

Audrey has taken care our our Portuguese water dog since we got her!  (Almost 4 years ago!). Pepper loves seeing Audrey every month and always looks amazing after her “spa day”.  We highly recommend Audrey as a groomer, a kind and thoughtful business woman, and a genuine animal lover!
Thank you Lacey! I love my Delilah visits 🩷 …
Audrey is the best! She is so caring and sweet  with my dog and always does and amazing job with her haircut!
My pug Zoey loves her "spa day".❤️❤️❤️

Wherever Audrey has been, we have followed.  Audrey bathed and brushed my Duffy dog for many years. He was a terrier mix who truly disliked water and baths. Audrey was so patient with him, even when he got dementia and yowled all through his bath. Audrey was there to say goodbye to him as he crossed the rainbow bridge and that gave me comfort.  Now I have another terrier mix, Fergus, who dislikes water and baths but he loves Audrey. Audrey found a perforation in his anal  sac a year ago and we got Fergus into the vet the same day before it got infected. Our vet was impressed but not surprised as he had worked with Audrey for years. So excited for Audrey and Raquel to have their own place. I highly recommend FurSure.
Raquel never fails to get our boy looking & smelling the best!! Worth every penny. So happy to have Fur Sure Grooming!!!!!
We love Audrey! She & the other lovely groomers have created a calm, quiet environment our dogs love. AND she grooms like a boss! Can't ask for much more than that.
Always a pleasure, always satisfied.

Audrey has been grooming my dogs for several years. I have always been beyond happy with her work, and even more pleased that knowing she is kind & keeps them safe while in her care. You know you have a great groomer when you say to your dogs “let’s  go see Audrey” & they run to the door with wagging tails!! I HIGHLY recommend Fur Sure Grooming for your fur babies.
Best place to go! Our dogs look amazing!

I was so impressed with Fur Sure Grooming! Raquel made me feel comfortable right away dropping my new rescue off. She made sure he was comfortable and really took her time with him. He is so soft and smells great! The price was very reasonable, the shop was easy to find and neat, the entire process was so smooth.  We will definitely be returning.
Great place to bring your pets. Audrey is amazing and always does a great job

I've been bringing my dogs, Luke and Kosmo, to Raquel and Audrey for years for grooming, and they now have their very own spot called Fur Sure Grooming! I can’t say enough great things about Raquel and Audrey they are absolutely wonderful, professional, kind, and clearly passionate about what they do.

Kosmo can be a bit anxious and Luke can be a wiggle butt, but Raquel and Audrey always handle them with such care and patience. They take the time to make the dogs feel comfortable, and it really shows in the final result. They both always come out looking handsome and happy.

I truly trust them with my pups, and that peace of mind is priceless.

Highly recommend Fur Sure Grooming Raquel and Audrey are the dream team!
Audrey we are So glad you are back ! Stella loved her morning with you and I loved her hair cut.  Thank you!!!

So, my dog, Luke, used to get groomed a few times a year by an amazing lady named Audrey who worked at our vet's office. Last year, the office removed grooming services, sadly. Audrey and her friend ended up opening their own little grooming studio, and today Luke got to go see her for a bath & brush with all the "extras." I know that most people won't drive 40 minutes to get their dogs groomed, but I will, because I love Audrey and how she treats the animals that come to see her. If any Central Phoenix or Westside people are in need of a friendly, gentle, and kind groomer, Audrey is your girl. The studio is in an old, unassuming strip mall, but pure magic happens inside. I'll gladly make the trek to ensure that Luke is treated right and everything is done meticulously well. We love Audrey! 🐾

Audrey has been amazing with our crew every time we have seen her and ours is a handful. With four dogs it can be a pain to get them groomed all at one appointment but she has always made it seamless and our dogs love her. Couldn’t recommend more!
They do the best job! Especially with stubborn and reactive dogs. We always have the best experience!
